text:
Iris - Product: @channel heads-up: new "Export Control & Regional Crypto Policy" for Private/VPC/on-prem is published today. Effective 2026-12-01. Short summary: HSM workflows and attestation handshakes now default to region-restricted crypto profiles; customers in restricted jurisdictions will need explicit export approvals. Please read bullets and action items below. :triangular_flag_on_post:

Ken - Eng-Security: quick Q — which countries are "restricted"?

Iris - Product: initial restricted list posted in the KB (high level): CountryA, CountryB, CountryC. Legal owns exact list and the approval flow. We will update quarterly.

Maya - Legal: correct — adding: any HSM-based attestation that exports key material or signed nonces crossing borders requires an export control review. New contracts after 2026-12-01 will include an export-control disclosure checkbox. For existing customers, we'll run a 90-day notice and provide an exception intake form.

Omar - Customer Success: customers will ask if this blocks HSM attestation for them — what's the customer-facing guidance?

Iris - Product: guidance: (1) If customer is in a restricted country, recommend vendor-signed image path (no HSM handshake); (2) If customer insists on HSM path, Legal + Security review and explicit written approval required; (3) Fallback = read-only remote-debug with local log bundling. We'll publish an FAQ and a templated outreach email.

tia.sales: need field copy for quoting and a short script for sales engineers — will coordinate with Omar and Maya.

Ken - Eng-Security: tech notes: attestation handshake will support two crypto profiles: "regional" (no outbound key material, default) and "cross-border" (requires approval). We'll add a validation check in provisioning that warns the user and blocks cross-border HSM until approval token is provided. Implementation owner: Ken -> due 2026-11-10.

support-bot: feature flag "private.export_control_v1" toggled ON in staging at 2026-10-02T12:00Z.

Iris - Product: Action items (owners + dates):
- Legal (Maya) -> export checklist + exception intake form + contract checkbox -> due 2026-10-20
- Eng-Security (Ken) -> provisioning validation + crypto-profile support + UI warning -> due 2026-11-10
- CS (Omar) -> customer FAQ + outreach email template + webinar plan -> due 2026-10-25
- Sales (tia.sales) -> field script + quote language -> due 2026-10-27

Maya - Legal: noting export paperwork lead times — if customers request cross-border HSM, expect multimonth approvals in some cases. We'll flag high-risk accounts to CS.

Iris - Product: We'll cover this in next Private sync (Thursday 9am PT). Please DM if you have urgent blockers. Thanks all — this keeps our on-prem story compliant while preserving customer options. :white_check_mark:
